record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare SPITE (catalog passive NONE, maxPP 90, range 1, types GHOST/HUMAN). The strategy is shared; they differ in stars (1 and 2) and stats.

dispatch.routingNote: REFERENCES_OTHER_ABILITIES resolved: SpiteStrategy mentions Ability.PSYCHIC_FANGS only as the skill id of a broadcastAbility animation; it does not call another strategy.

record.summary: PP drain and redistribution, no damage. After the base process (PP spent, default animation suppressed) and a PSYCHIC_FANGS-id animation broadcast, the strategy requests addPP(-ppDrain, caster, apBoost 1, crit) on the cast target, with ppDrain = [20, 40, 60, 100] by caster stars (YAMASK 20, COFAGRIGUS 40). It then collects the caster's adjacent units of its own team (the up to 8 neighbouring cells, caster excluded) and, if there are n >= 1, requests addPP(ppDrain / n, caster, 1, crit) on each. The amount given is based on the requested ppDrain, not on how much PP the target actually lost, and AP / crit are applied again inside each addPP call. addPP computes round(base x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if the cast crit), halves positive amounts under fatigue, flips a negative amount for a Twist Band holder when the source is an enemy, blocks positive values on silenced / status.protect / NO_PP_GAIN units, blocks all values on a resurrecting unit and negative values on a tree unit, then clamps to 0..2 x maxPP - 1. With no adjacent ally, nothing is given. If the target is protected, silenced or otherwise unaffected the allies still receive PP; Rune Protect alone blocks neither the drain nor the gain.

targeting.who: the cast target (PP drain); the caster's same-team units in the 8 cells around the caster (PP gain)
targeting.note: Allies are any occupied adjacent cell with a unit of the caster's team (units whose hp is 0 are not filtered in the code read). The caster itself is not in the set. The target need not be adjacent.

geometry.shape: single target for the drain; the 8-neighbour ring around the caster for the gain

effects.scaling: requested = -ppDrain; addPP value = round(-ppDrain x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit flag is true)); AP is the caster's at cast time; the crit flag is rolled only with ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false. Fatigue halves only positive requests, so it does not change the drain.
effects.resolution: applied: Twist Band on the target turns a drain from an enemy into a gain; the change is dropped while the target is resurrecting or has status.tree; otherwise pp = clamp(pp + value, 0, 2 x maxPP - 1), so the PP actually lost is at most the target's current PP and can be less than the requested amount (core-mechanics section J3, probe SHARED_HELPERS). Protect / silence do not block a negative value. Not damage: shields and HP are untouched.

declaredRaw.ppGivenEach: ppDrain / n (n = number of adjacent allies)

effects.scaling: requested per ally = ppDrain / n (not rounded); addPP value = round(ppDrain / n x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower on a cast crit) x (0.5 if the ally has fatigue)). It does not depend on the PP actually drained from the target.
effects.resolution: applied: dropped for a silenced ally, one with status.protect (not Rune Protect), the NO_PP_GAIN effect, or resurrecting; otherwise pp = clamp(pp + value, 0, 2 x maxPP - 1) so the stored change can be smaller near the cap; Twist Band does not flip (same team); Big Eater Belt is not applied by addPP (section J3). A unit already at PP cap gains nothing. The sum given can exceed the PP the target lost.

starBehavior.note: The PP table is indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star (60) and 4-star (100) entries and the fallback 100 are not reachable by the listed units' bare star counts. Geometry does not vary by stars.

record.positionalConditions: The gain goes only to same-team units standing directly around the caster (8 neighbours); with none adjacent only the drain happens. The drain needs the cast target (requiresTarget true) but not adjacency.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes; each cast acts immediately (no delayed command).
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: drain ppDrain (20 YAMASK / 40 COFAGRIGUS) x (1 + AP/100) x critPower on crit from the target; ppDrain / n x (1 + AP/100) x critPower on crit to each of n adjacent allies. Applied: the target loses at most its current PP (clamp at 0), nothing if resurrecting or tree, and gains PP instead under a Twist Band; each ally gains per addPP (fatigue halving, silence / protect / NO_PP_GAIN / resurrecting blocks, cap 2 x maxPP - 1, rounding per ally). Allies' total gain is computed from the requested amount, so it is not conserved with the target's actual loss.
